verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online ships its own AI assistant (Intuit Intelligence), so asking whether it can connect external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The evidence shows no way to plug third-party MCP servers into it. The Intuit QuickBooks Online MCP server is the opposite role: it serves QuickBooks tools to other agents, so it earns no credit for this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
